instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='plus-fab-button').
Use standard JS / JSX code files (no TypeScript extensions like .tsx).
Implement the '+' FAB role chooser in the home page bottom navigation, opening a sheet modal allowing users to choose 'Become a Creator' (3-step form) or 'Hire as a Business' (2-step offer form).
Use Lucide React or Phosphor Icons for crisp visual cues across navigation, cards, status badges, and buttons.

Include realistic Indian currency ₹ (INR) pricing and plans: Per Video (Starts at ₹499 - ₹2,999), Part-Time (₹8,000 - ₹20,000/mo), Full-Time (₹25,000 - ₹60,000/mo) and Business Pro Subscription (₹999/mo).
Provide interactive state switches (Creator mode vs Business mode) in profile and global headers so users can seamlessly explore both sides of the marketplace.
Deliver a complete, workable app with rich mock data, deal pipeline transitions, chat thread simulations, notification feed, and admin review panel.
